name: @w6w-apps/bitbucket
description: Read repositories, workspaces and manage webhooks on Bitbucket Cloud.

w6w.longDescription:
Bitbucket gives a workflow visibility into repositories and workspaces on Bitbucket Cloud, and control over the webhooks that make that visibility programmatic — listing workspaces and their repositories, fetching a single repository's details, and reading the event history at both the repository and workspace level.

Webhook management is a full create/list/delete surface at two scopes: hooks can be managed on an individual repository, or on a workspace as a whole so one webhook covers every repository inside it — the right choice for a process that needs to react across an entire team's repositories rather than wiring up each one separately.

Useful for connecting Bitbucket into a broader engineering workflow — auditing which webhooks exist across a workspace, provisioning new ones as part of onboarding a repository, or pulling repository and event data into a dashboard or another tool.
